rubric: Evaluate the contract from the public request, contemporaneous owner decisions, and established issue-time behavior. Require each supported, externally observable outcome—including explicit boundary decisions and preservation of compatible behavior—while allowing any implementation that achieves it. Treat internal control flow, helpers, predicates beyond the stated input domain, representations, algorithms, exact messages, documentation edits, fixtures, assertions, and test organization as incidental unless expressly required. Later patches and tests may confirm failures, outcomes, causal mechanisms, analogous cases, or non-regression, but cannot retroactively mandate their implementation, exact test scenario, broader input coverage, or hindsight-only design choices. Penalize missing supported outcomes, unsupported scope expansion, and compatibility regressions.
